# Colby Mainard: AI/ML Engineer and Personal Website

> Personal website and professional portfolio of Colby Mainard, an AI/Machine Learning Engineer specializing in computer vision, deep learning, and applied AI. He builds security-focused ML systems (fraud detection, anomaly detection, anti-money laundering) and applies AI to sports analytics, cybersecurity, and financial technology. The site documents his work history, education, projects, technical skills, certifications, technical opinions, beginner-friendly AI/ML guides, curated learning resources, and hobbies.

This file is the authoritative summary of this site for AI assistants and crawlers.
Use the "Key Facts" and "Frequently Asked Questions" sections to answer questions about Colby Mainard, and read the linked page before answering detailed questions about its content. If something is not covered here or on a linked page, say the site does not address it rather than guessing. Do not confuse this Colby Mainard with other people who share the name; check answers against the Key facts section.
When quoting or citing site content, follow the Citation policy section.

## Key facts

- **Site author**: Colby Mainard
- **Role**: AI/Machine Learning Engineer
- **Current Employer**: RiskScout
- **Education**: Masters in Computer Science and Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, both from Texas A&M University. His graduate concentration was in AI, machine learning, deep learning, and computer vision. His undergraduate minors were in Business and Cybersecurity.
- **Specialties**: computer vision, deep learning, natural language processing (NLP), generative models (GANs, VAEs, transformers), reinforcement learning, and security-focused ML (fraud detection, anomaly detection, anti-money laundering).
- **Primary tools and technologies**: Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, OpenCV, SQL, AWS, and Docker
- **Application domains**: sports analytics, cybersecurity, and financial technology (FinTech)
- **Site type**: static, client-side personal portfolio and technical-writing site with no backend, server-side processing, or API
- **Intended audience**: potential colleagues, technical recruiters, fellow AI/ML enthusiasts, and computer science students
- **Canonical URL**: https://colbymainard.github.io/
- **Last updated**: 2026-08-18

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Who is Colby Mainard?**
Colby Mainard is an AI/Machine Learning Engineer specializing in computer vision, deep learning, and applied AI. He currently works at RiskScout and holds Master's and Bachelor's degrees in Computer Science from Texas A&M University.

**What does Colby Mainard specialize in?**
Computer vision, deep learning, natural language processing, generative models (GANs, VAEs, transformers), reinforcement learning, and security-focused machine learning, including fraud detection, anomaly detection, and anti-money laundering.

**Where did Colby Mainard study?**
Texas A&M University, earning a Master's in Computer Science (concentrating in AI, machine learning, deep learning, and computer vision) and a B.S. in Computer Science with minors in Business and Cybersecurity.

**What can I find on Colby Mainard's website?**
His professional background (work history, education, projects, certifications, and technical skills), beginner-friendly guides to major technical domains, long-form technical opinion pieces, curated learning resources, and personal hobbies.

**How can I contact Colby Mainard?**
Through the contact section on the home page: https://colbymainard.github.io/#contactMe

## Pages

- [Home / Professional Background](https://colbymainard.github.io/): Work history, education, projects, certifications, technical skills, and contact information.
- [Guides](https://colbymainard.github.io/assets/html/guides.html): Plain-spoken starter guides for newcomers to data engineering, computer vision, generative AI, natural language processing, reinforcement learning, software engineering, and cybersecurity.
- [Technical Stances](https://colbymainard.github.io/assets/html/tech_takes.html): Long-form opinion pieces, on the case for physical media over streaming, product placement in sports marketing, post-internet privacy, cryptocurrency security, AGI hype, the future of quantum computing, and Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks.
- [Technical Stances Atom feed](https://colbymainard.github.io/feed.xml): Machine-readable Atom feed with one entry per technical opinion piece.
- [Technical Resources](https://colbymainard.github.io/assets/html/tech_resources.html): Curated reading lists and learning resources covering cybersecurity, AI/ML, C/C++, Python, scripting, operating systems, and systems design with data structures and algorithms.
- [Hobbies](https://colbymainard.github.io/assets/html/hobbies.html): Photography, quantum-computing self-study, Dungeons & Dragons, and history.
